fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Matt Landman returns to bring a little silver lining to our perspectives. In this episode we talk about his EMF shielding apparel (Spero Protection Clothing), the 5G rollout, and why wearing a mask as we've been instructed to do is not in our best interests. We also cover the deep importance of breath, some of the symbolic/historical significance of masks, and the accelerating plan to divide people through mainstream news and social media.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title":"A Scripted Stage Where Both Sides Answer to the Same Hand","body":"Chance opens the members hour with a prediction he admits may be too close for comfort: that the 5G rollout could be followed by a wave of illness branded a second wave, handing Trump emergency powers and a reason to cancel the election. Matt answers that Trump is going nowhere, points to Putin writing himself into office for life, and hears predictive programming of a war with China. The two question who made fact checkers the arbiters of truth, and Matt describes a staged 5G video allowed to go viral before it was pulled."},{"title":"Numbers as Spellwork in the Headlines","body":"Chance builds on a members-only solo show, tracing the Jesuit signature number 201 through Georgetown, where Fauci gave his commencement speech, and through QAnon in Jewish gematria. His argument is that these numeric fingerprints bypass the conscious mind while the subconscious registers the links, which makes them a kind of spell work. He later adds that Bill Gates reduces to 33 while William Henry Gates totals 201, and he reads the reported May the fourth birthday of Elon Musk's child as another deliberate number, tying the boy to a Star Wars mythology of godlike power."},{"title":"Dystopian Films and the California Breakaway","body":"Matt walks through the films he reads as predictive programming, from The Handmaid's Tale to Brazil and Demolition Man, and sees their breakaway California playing out now. Thrift stores asking whether you left the county, tennis rules that differ state to state, and a president tweeting about looting and shooting all feed what he calls othering, the scarlet letter that turns yesterday's drinking buddy into someone to stone. He predicts California will split off, go tech heavy with mega cities, and become the place where human rights give way to cyborgs, while the pair note a real company sharing the fictional state's name, Gilead."},{"title":"Neuralink and the Child Named for the Machine","body":"Matt recounts watching Elon Musk describe Neuralink on Joe Rogan's show, with fine wires threaded into the brain and full AI integration imagined as the end goal. When Rogan asked how anyone would go back to being normal once they were a god and Musk agreed, Matt asked his friend to turn it off. Chance decodes the name X Æ A-12 as unknown variable, artificial intelligence and an aircraft or archangel, and wonders whether the child is being groomed as a poster boy for cyborgs. Matt counters with his dream of farm schools that honor children instead of screening them."},{"title":"Truth Boxes, Attention and Slow Creation","body":"Matt unveils his Traveling Truth Box, a parcel of books, films and music like They Live, Dark City, 1984 and Brave New World that passes by media mail from one truther to the next. Chance praises printed pages that cannot be edited at a click, recalling a headline that changed days after he decoded it, and calls the mind the most valuable real estate in the attention economy. Matt insists that we are light slowed into matter, creators who must trust baby steps, and urges listeners to email their city councils about 5G rather than wait for a hero."}]

fields.Plus Quotes JSON: [{"text":"People need to snap out of the media being anything but a social engineering tool.","author":"Matt Landman","portrait":""},{"text":"Both sides of all these different polarizations are strings being pulled by the same puppet masters.","author":"Chance Garton","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"Really, we have to get spiritual and break away from all of this to really see the light and see how messed up it really is.","author":"Matt Landman","portrait":""},{"text":"Othering is the scarlet letter where you can get up and stone your fellow human when one year ago you guys were best friends drinking at a bar sharing germs.","author":"Matt Landman","portrait":""},{"text":"The real estate that's most valuable is what's in your mind.","author":"Chance Garton","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"That objective reality is derived from a base subjectivity that you can never escape from. There is no blank canvas to find that the molecules of the universe are painted upon.","author":"Chance Garton","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"We are amazing creators, but we have to believe in the power of baby steps towards big goals and making something happen, not overnight.","author":"Matt Landman","portrait":""},{"text":"Take away something that you already had and replace it with a counterfeit version that has some agenda behind it.","author":"Chance Garton","portrait":"https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"},{"text":"And really, at the end of it all, you can shine your light so bright that you light the way for others that really needed that.","author":"Matt Landman","portrait":""},{"text":"I just think it's really important to see the darkness like you referenced, and then knowing that there's darkness, you know that there's light.","author":"Matt Landman","portrait":""}]
